A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Color/Legends|pink]]-skinned '''[[pachydermoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was short of stature with large three-fingered hands and two-toed feet. The species had a prominent trunk and [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]], but lacked visible [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="Debut" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] of this species first appeared seventh episode of the animated series, ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'', titled ''[[The Pirates of Tarnoonga]]''.<ref name="Debut" />

This [[Wookieepedia]] article inspired [[Delilah S. Dawson]] to include [[Unidentified pink pachydermoid species|this species]] in her [[canon]] comic [[Star Wars Adventures (2017) 25|''Star Wars Adventures'' (2017) 25]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|DelilahSDawson|status/1171933190845554690|[[Delilah S. Dawson]]|quote=Nah, I just found 'em in the Wookieepedia: [Link to Wookieepedia article]|archivedate=20190927060732|archivefile=File:DelilahSDawson-PinkElephantSpecies-Twitter.png|nolive=1}}</ref>
